witos.Platform.KnownOperatingSystem: WitOS is neither Windows, Linux, macOS nor FreeBSD: an application that infers Windows from 'not Linux and not macOS' misbehaves there (RFC 0015 §1, ADR 0024).
witos.Platform.ProcessStart: System.Diagnostics.Process is not supported until it rides the libc's posix_spawn over the process manager (RFC 0015 §8, Compatibility-Differences: Processes).
witos.FileIO.Watcher: System.IO.FileSystem.Watcher is not supported: the namespace service sends no change notifications (Compatibility-Differences: File change notifications).
witos.Synchronization.NamedMutex: .NET keeps named synchronization objects under the fixed /tmp/.dotnet, whatever TMPDIR says, and WitOS has no /tmp (Compatibility-Differences: Named synchronization objects).
